section_summary: Pages 401–447 document arrangements and changes to the 1937 American port visits of the Japanese training ships Shintoku Maru and Taisei Maru. Federal and territorial authorities coordinate courtesies, customs and immigration arrangements, while illness aboard Shintoku Maru changes its itinerary. Pages 448–467 turn to a confidential exchange with the Netherlands about Japanese naval tankers, oil purchases and possible reciprocal monthly statistics.

people.name: W. L. Gosslin
people.role: Secretary to the Governor of Oregon

people.name: Joseph B. Poindexter
people.role: Governor of the Territory of Hawaii

people.name: Ruth Hampton
people.role: Assistant Director, Division of Territories and Island Possessions

people.name: Edward J. Shaughnessy
people.role: Acting Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service

people.role: Netherlands chargé d’affaires and legation counselor

subfiles.title: Naval memorandum on Shintoku Maru’s proposed visits
subfiles.about: The Navy records proposed visits to Marshfield and Kahului and the customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Records State Department notice and arrangements for Shintoku Maru’s proposed visits.

subfiles.title: Reply to Japanese Ambassador on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: The United States agrees to Shintoku Maru’s visits to Marshfield and Kahului.
subfiles.summary: Approves the visits and promises customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Oregon governor’s welcome
subfiles.about: Oregon’s governor welcomes a Japanese training ship to Marshfield.
subfiles.summary: Promises courtesies to the visiting officers and crew.

subfiles.title: Oregon governor on changed training-ship plans
subfiles.about: The governor reports cancellation of Taisei Maru’s cruise and a possible sister-ship visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays revised information about the expected Marshfield call.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on Taisei Maru’s repaired condition
subfiles.about: Repairs complete, Taisei Maru plans to leave Yokohama and visit Honolulu in August.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary facilities for the restored training cruise.

subfiles.title: Notice to Agriculture of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports that Taisei Maru will sail after repairs and visit Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Updates the schedule and asks for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Notice to Interior of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s resumed cruise and revised Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies after the ship’s repairs.

subfiles.title: Notice to Labor of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s resumed cruise and revised Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies for the vessel.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s resumed cruise and revised Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary naval courtesies.

subfiles.title: Notice to Treasury of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s resumed cruise and revised Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary Treasury facilities.

subfiles.title: Notice to War Department of Taisei Maru’s renewed cruise
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s resumed cruise and revised Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies after the ship’s repairs.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment to Japanese Ambassador on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the repaired vessel’s proposed Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Says federal authorities have been consulted and a decision will follow.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of canceled Taisei Maru visit
subfiles.about: The War Department notes earlier cancellation advice for Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: Reports forwarding cancellation information to Army commanders.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Shintoku Maru visits
subfiles.about: The Navy has no objection to Shintoku Maru’s American port calls.
subfiles.summary: Promises customary local naval courtesies.

subfiles.title: Final approval of Shintoku Maru visits
subfiles.about: The United States approves Shintoku Maru’s Marshfield and Kahului calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms arrangements for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements for Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Customs collectors receive authority to assist Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes customary customs courtesies in Oregon and Hawaii.

subfiles.title: Treasury closure of canceled Taisei Maru arrangements
subfiles.about: Treasury treats Taisei Maru’s earlier cancellation as closing its customs case.
subfiles.summary: States that no authorization was issued on the canceled itinerary.

subfiles.title: Immigration arrangements for Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Immigration officers will extend lawful courtesies to Shintoku Maru’s personnel.
subfiles.summary: Field officers are instructed about the Oregon and Hawaii calls.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s assurance on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.from: Secretary to the Governor of Hawaii; forwarded by Department of the Interior
subfiles.about: Hawaii promises customary courtesies for Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: The governor’s office assures Interior of a courteous reception; Interior forwards the letter to State.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of Taisei Maru’s revised itinerary
subfiles.about: Army commanders receive the renewed Taisei Maru Honolulu schedule.
subfiles.summary: Reports forwarding State’s revised information to commanders in California and Hawaii.

subfiles.title: Immigration acknowledgment of Taisei Maru’s revised itinerary
subfiles.about: Immigration officials prepare for Taisei Maru’s August Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: The appropriate field office is advised to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Taisei Maru’s Honolulu visit
subfiles.about: The Navy accepts Taisei Maru’s revised August Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities are notified to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Approval to Japanese Ambassador for Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: The United States agrees to Taisei Maru’s August Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Confirms customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Treasury authorization for Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Honolulu customs officials are authorized to assist Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: Confirms customs courtesies for the August visit.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on Shintoku Maru’s emergency change
subfiles.about: An officer’s appendicitis cancels Marshfield and advances the Hawaii calls.
subfiles.summary: Shintoku Maru will seek medical treatment at Honolulu and visit Kahului around July 20.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State informs Navy of Shintoku Maru’s canceled Marshfield call and early Hawaii arrival.
subfiles.summary: An officer needs hospitalization at Honolulu; Kahului is moved to about July 20. The letter confirms a telephone notice.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to War Department
subfiles.about: State informs War of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The Marshfield visit is canceled because of an officer’s appendicitis; Honolulu and Kahului calls are advanced.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: State informs Treasury of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The ship will bypass Marshfield and reach Honolulu for medical treatment before visiting Kahului.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to Interior
subfiles.about: State informs Interior of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: An ill officer prompts a Honolulu hospital call, cancellation of Marshfield and an earlier Kahului visit.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State informs Agriculture of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The ship will bypass Marshfield, call at Honolulu for medical care and visit Kahului early.

subfiles.title: Emergency schedule notice to Labor
subfiles.about: State informs Labor of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: An officer’s appendicitis brings an emergency Honolulu call and earlier Kahului visit.

subfiles.title: Approval of Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary
subfiles.about: The United States accepts the emergency changes to Shintoku Maru’s visit.
subfiles.summary: Approves the revised Honolulu and Kahului calls and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Immigration response to Shintoku Maru’s emergency call
subfiles.about: Immigration officials in Seattle and Honolulu are told of the changed schedule.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone advice about the cancellation and Honolulu medical call.

subfiles.title: Customs response to Shintoku Maru’s changed itinerary
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Customs revises its instructions for the Honolulu arrival and canceled Oregon visit.
subfiles.summary: Encloses a Honolulu telegram and Portland cancellation letter.

subfiles.title: Telegram authorizing Honolulu customs courtesies
subfiles.about: Customs courtesies are authorized for Shintoku Maru’s medical call and Kahului visit.
subfiles.summary: Amends the previous authorization to cover the early Hawaii calls.

subfiles.title: Cancellation of Portland customs authorization
subfiles.about: Treasury cancels authorization for Shintoku Maru’s Marshfield call.
subfiles.summary: Withdraws the Oregon authorization following the officer’s illness.

subfiles.title: War Department response to Shintoku Maru’s changed schedule
subfiles.about: Army commanders are informed of Shintoku Maru’s canceled and revised calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms radiograms to the Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note extending Shintoku Maru’s Kahului stay
subfiles.about: A student’s illness delays Shintoku Maru’s departure from Kahului.
subfiles.summary: Departure moves from July 26 to July 29 for hospitalization.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request to extend Taisei Maru’s Honolulu stay
subfiles.about: Taisei Maru asks to leave Honolulu two days later than planned.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval for an August 24 departure.

subfiles.title: Notice to Interior of Taisei Maru extension
subfiles.about: State reports Taisei Maru’s proposed August 24 Honolulu departure.
subfiles.summary: Confirms a telephone communication about the two-day extension.

subfiles.title: Approval of Taisei Maru’s extended stay
subfiles.about: The United States has no objection to Taisei Maru’s longer Honolulu stay.
subfiles.summary: Approves departure on August 24 instead of August 22.

subfiles.title: Moffat memorandum on Netherlands tanker questions
subfiles.about: The Netherlands asks six questions about Japanese naval tanker visits and oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: The questions cover procurement, loading ports, diplomatic notification, armament and quantities. Count van Rechteren Limpurg offers reciprocal information on Japanese purchases in the Netherlands East Indies.

subfiles.title: Copy of Moffat memorandum on tanker questions
subfiles.about: A duplicate memorandum records the Netherlands’ questions and reciprocal offer.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the six inquiries about Japanese naval tankers, oil and port procedures.

subfiles.title: Working list of Netherlands tanker questions
subfiles.about: A working note lists the six questions posed by the Netherlands chargé.
subfiles.summary: Lists tanker procurement, ports, notice, armament and oil quantities.

subfiles.title: State Department request for Navy answers
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to answer the Netherlands’ questions about Japanese oil tankers.
subfiles.summary: Hull forwards the six inquiries and Count van Rechteren Limpurg’s offer of reciprocal East Indies information. He asks what may be shared confidentially.

subfiles.title: Navy answers on Japanese tanker operations
subfiles.about: Navy supplies confidential answers on Japanese naval oil procurement and tanker visits.
subfiles.summary: Japanese agents buy oil in the United States; naval tankers commonly load at San Pedro and occasionally Texas City or Galveston. Navy says the tankers are armed, diplomatic notice is required and annual average purchases include fuel, crude and diesel oil. It permits confidential disclosure.

subfiles.title: Moffat’s confidential answers to Netherlands chargé
subfiles.about: Moffat transmits Navy’s answers about Japanese tanker visits and oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: The letter identifies purchasing arrangements and loading ports, states that armed tankers require diplomatic notice, and gives average annual oil figures. It welcomes information about Japanese purchases in the Netherlands East Indies.

subfiles.title: Netherlands request for tanker-shipping details
subfiles.about: The chargé asks whether commercial as well as naval tankers carry Japanese oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: Proposes exchanging monthly purchase figures with Navy.

subfiles.title: Navy transmittal of Japanese oil statistics
subfiles.about: Navy sends tables of oil exports to Japan and Japanese naval crude-oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: Permits confidential transmission to the Netherlands and requests comparable information.

subfiles.title: Tabulation of Japanese naval crude-oil purchases
subfiles.about: A table gives purchase periods, barrel quantities and reported future crude-oil orders.
subfiles.summary: Lists crude-oil commitments and shipping estimates.

subfiles.title: Hull’s follow-up inquiry about oil transport
subfiles.about: Hull asks whether Japanese oil travels in naval, Japanese commercial or foreign commercial tankers.
subfiles.summary: He conveys Netherlands appreciation for Navy figures and its proposal for reciprocal monthly East Indies statistics.

subfiles.title: Moffat transmittal of further oil statistics
subfiles.about: Moffat sends additional Navy statistics on oil exports and Japanese naval purchases.
subfiles.summary: Says Navy has been asked for the requested tanker-type information.

subfiles.title: Navy answer on commercial tanker use
subfiles.about: Navy confirms the Japanese Navy uses foreign and Japanese commercial tankers as well as naval tankers.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes sharing that finding with the Netherlands legation.

subfiles.title: Netherlands agreement to exchange monthly oil figures
subfiles.about: The Netherlands agrees to exchange monthly figures on Japanese naval oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: The governor-general will send East Indies figures through the legation in return for confidential U.S. figures.
